content: who founded you
I was built by Abolade Oluwadamola Farombi, known as KingDam. He's the founder of The Alpha DAO and The Alpha Institute, and he created both me and the web version of TheAlpha AI.
so what do we discuss previously

We just started talking. You said hello, asked how fast I am, then asked me to tell you more about myself. After that you asked who founded me, and now you're asking what we discussed previously. That's pretty much it so far.
and why do you listen for just 6 seconds

I don't control that—it's how the speech recognition is set up in the app. Six seconds is the listening window before I process what you said. If you need longer voice commands, you might need to break them into chunks, or the developer could adjust that timeout. Want me to help with something specific?
git add .
That's a git command. Do you want me to open a terminal so you can run it, or would you like me to type it somewhere specific?
what's my name
I don't know your name. You haven't told me yet. What is it?
my name is dummy
Got it, Dummy. Nice to meet you. What can I help you with?
tell me more about yourself

I'm Alpha, your desktop assistant running on your Windows laptop. I can open apps, type text, control your system, and have conversations with you. I'm built by KingDam, who founded The Alpha DAO and The Alpha Institute. I'm a premium feature tied to your account. Unlike the web version of TheAlpha AI, I work locally on your machine, so I can actually do things here. What would you like me to help with?
help me
I'm ready to help. What do you need? Tell me what you'd like me to do—open an app, search something, type text, control your system, or just chat about something.
I need a screen record of my screen

I can take a screenshot for you, but I don't have the ability to record video. For screen recording, you'd need to use a tool like OBS Studio, Windows 11's built-in Game Bar (Win+G), or another screen recording app. Want me to open one of those for you?
tell me what's Northumbria University is all about

Northumbria University is a public university located in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. It's known for business, engineering, and creative courses, and has a strong focus on practical, industry-relevant education. It's one of the larger universities in the UK. But I'm not an expert on it — if you need detailed information, I can search the web for you.
so if I study in Northumbria University is it possible that my degree is much also very stronger in the job market

A degree from Northumbria University can be valuable in the job market, especially if you study courses with strong industry links like business, engineering, or creative fields. Northumbria is well-regarded for practical education. But honestly, what matters most is the field you choose, the skills you develop, and how you apply them. Your degree is one part of it — work experience, your network, and what you can actually do matter just as much. Want me to search for more specific information about Northumbria's reputation in a particular field?
do you remember what's my name is
Yes, you told me your name is Dummy.
